html:
The Umiida are an Aboriginal people of the west Kimberley in Western Australia, in country north of King Sound and the town of Derby.

Their language belongs to the Worrorran family. Neighbours on the map include the Worrorra to the north, the Unggumi and the Warrwa to the south, and the Ngarinyin inland. Little is recorded about them separately, and many Umiida people later lived alongside Worrorra people at missions and in Derby. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Umiida are an Aboriginal people of the west Kimberley in Western Australia, in country north of King Sound and the town of Derby.
